text.en:
Section one hundred and five of Act Num-bered Fourteen hundred and fifty-nine, as amended
by act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and ten, is further amended by adding after the last paragraph thereof the
"(7) Loans secured by deposits in said bank in amounts not exceeding ninety per centum of such deposits."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, June 9, 1938.
